text:
sara (partnerships): FYI, LangChain product lead asked to sync on a joint gateway + orchestration story next week. They want a co-bundle for cloud marketplaces and a joint announcement window. :wave:

leah (product): Nice. Do they expect feature parity with our Gateway adapters or a pilot first?

sara (partnerships): Pilot first. They proposed a 6-week pilot scoped to LlamaIndex connectors + an orchestration quickstart using their runner. Goal: marketplace listing + customer case study.

tom (eng): I can scope the adapter effort. Quick question — do we ship a dedicated adapter or point them to our existing gateway shim?

andrew (platform): For marketplace & Dedicated customers we should offer a stamped adapter (small package) so SI/partners can onboard quickly. But for GA we want an official integration in the orchestrator.

maria (marketing): Tentatively, if we can commit to pilot by Apr 10 we can coordinate a mid-May announcement and a joint webinar. Need assets & one customer quote.

leah (product): Sounds reasonable. Proposed pilot scope (high level):
```
- LangChain adapter + LlamaIndex connector (basic retrieval)
- Orchestrator runbook + example DAG for hybrid routing
- Marketplace listing metadata + billing mapping
- Pilot checklist and SLOs (latency, cost)
```

sara (partnerships): I'll own partner comms and the announcement timeline. Tom, can you take the adapter POC? Andrew can you own packaging for marketplace and Dedicated? Maria will do comms & webinar.

tom (eng): I can take the POC. ETA for a minimal adapter + tests: 2 weeks (by 1718138000). Will need a small env from platform for end-to-end.

andrew (platform): I can provide a sandbox Dedicated pool and help with packaging. Can we pin a minimal GPU profile? I recommend a 1xA10-ish config for pilot.

maria (marketing): I'll draft a one-pager for the webinar and a co-branded landing hero. Need partner logo and short partner blurb from LangChain.

leah (product): We should also surface a migration plan for customers currently using the Gateway shim. Add to the playbook: rollback steps, compatibility matrix.

sara (partnerships): Agreed. Preliminary milestones:
- Week 0: Partner kickoff + partner asset request (logos, blurb, legal)
- Week 1-2: Adapter POC + E2E test on sandbox (tom)
- Week 3: Orchestrator runbook & packaging (andrew)
- Week 4: Pilot onboarding + initial customer test
- Week 5-6: Metrics review & customer reference prep

andrew (platform): I'll add packaging checklist items: OCI bundle, marketplace metadata, sample pricing mapping.

tom (eng): Quick note: we should agree on data flow for KV caching and how LlamaIndex uses our prefix caching. If not documented, I'll add a short snippet in the repo.

leah (product): Add a perf target: 95th pctile token latency under pilot load < 300ms for short queries. Also target cost/unit threshold for marketplace listing.

maria (marketing): For the joint webinar, suggested talking points: integration story, demo (LangChain runner + LlamaIndex), customer demo, then Q&A. Who can demo? Tom/Andrew?

tom (eng): I can demo the adapter + DAG. Andrew can show packaging & marketplace flow.

release-bot: Deploy window notice: sandbox Dedicated pool will be provisioned on 1718129600 — please avoid disruptive infra changes during that window.

sara (partnerships): OK, action owners: tom (adapter POC), andrew (packaging/marketplace), maria (assets & webinar), leah (pilot SLOs & playbook), sara (partner ops & announcement calendar). Next sync: Tuesday 10am PT.

maria (marketing): I'll start a shared Notion doc and drop the link here once created. :memo:

tom (eng): small blocker: need a LangChain contact for runtime API expectation. @sara can you get an API contract by EOD tomorrow?

sara (partnerships): Yes — emailing them now. Will paste the contact + contract here once they reply.

andrew (platform): One ask for marketplace: confirm billing entity mapping for co-bundles (we need to know whether revenue share is per-token or per-seat). Can PD/legal flag?

leah (product): I'll loop in legal/finance after we have the partner's marketplace preference.

maria (marketing): thumbs up. Also thinking of a short 90s explainer vid for the listing. Will scope after we confirm demo flow.

sara (partnerships): Great. If nobody objects, I'll treat this as our canonical pilot plan and start scheduling the partner kickoff tomorrow. :thumbsup:

tom (eng): No objections from eng side.

andrew (platform): Good from platform.

leah (product): Go for it.

maria (marketing): Go ahead.

sara (partnerships): Kickoff scheduled for 1718131200 (see calendar invite). Thanks everyone — will update thread with partner contact + Notion link.
